facts.text: I am trying to keep track of my expenses for Max, my golden retriever.
I bought a new dog bed for Max from PetSmart.
I spent around $40 on Max's new dog bed from PetSmart.
I bought a new food bowl for Max from Amazon.
I bought a stainless steel food bowl for Max from Amazon.
I spent $15 on Max's stainless steel food bowl from Amazon.
The shipping for Max's food bowl from Amazon was really fast.
I changed Max's diet to a grain-free kibble recently.
I got a new measuring cup to ensure I was feeding Max the right amount.
The measuring cup cost $5 from the pet store down the street.
I do not remember the exact amount I spent on the grain-free kibble.
The grain-free kibble purchase was a one-time purchase.
I got a new shampoo from the vet for Max's bath.
I spent $10 on the shampoo from the vet for Max's bath.
I recently got a new brush for Max to reduce shedding.
